name: Quick Media Ingest
tagline: Ingest photos and videos into dated, shoot-based folders
pitch: Quick Media Ingest is a FOSS .NET 8 desktop app for photographers and videographers. It imports photos and videos from SD cards, local drives, and FTP into dated shoot-based destination folders with configurable naming, metadata options, and safety checks. Windows ships WPF; Linux ships an Avalonia ingest-bench .deb.
features: SD card, local drive, and FTP ingest with Unified source view
Dated shoot-based folders with configurable file naming
Duplicate policies, verification, and delete-after-import safety
WPF on Windows and Avalonia Fluent ingest-bench on Linux
Portable EXE, WiX MSI, and linux-x64 .deb via GitHub Releases
quick_start: Clone the repo and open QuickMediaIngest-1.sln in Visual Studio or `dotnet build`.
Linux: `bash scripts/install-dotnet-sdk-linux.sh` then `python3 scripts/agent-run.py feature-gate --stack dotnet-wpf`.
install: Windows: GitHub Releases portable EXE and WiX MSI. Linux: `quick-media-ingest` amd64 .deb to /opt/quick-media-ingest. See `modules/dotnet-wpf/MODULE.md` and `docs/LINUX_DEV.md`.
usage: Use `/verify` before merge and `/ship` to publish. Do not run `init-project.sh` or prune on this child product. Stack is `dotnet-wpf` only.
